rules.name: Business Logic — Price Manipulation
rules.description: Detects price manipulation attempts via negative quantities, zero-price items, or modified totals in checkout
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%business-logic%' OR payload ILIKE '%price-manipulation%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Business Logic — Rate Limit Bypass
rules.description: Detects API rate limit bypass attempts using header manipulation, IP rotation, or parameter tampering
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%business-logic%' OR payload ILIKE '%rate-limit%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Business Logic — Workflow Bypass
rules.description: Detects attempts to skip workflow steps or access later stages without completing prerequisites
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%business-logic%' OR payload ILIKE '%workflow-bypass%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Business Logic — Negative Quantity or Amount
rules.description: Detects transactions with negative quantities or amounts indicating business logic bypass
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%business-logic%' OR payload ILIKE '%negative-amount%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Error Handling — Verbose Error Information Disclosure
rules.description: Detects verbose error responses containing stack traces, database details, or internal paths
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%error-handling%' OR payload ILIKE '%information-disclosure%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Cryptography — Weak Hash Algorithm Usage
rules.description: Detects usage of weak hash algorithms (MD5, SHA1) in application transactions or certificate signatures
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%cryptography%' OR payload ILIKE '%weak-hash%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Data Classification — PII in Logs
rules.description: Detects PII data (SSN, credit card, email) appearing in application logs in cleartext
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%data-protection%' OR payload ILIKE '%pii-logging%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES

rules.name: Data Classification — Unencrypted Data at Rest
rules.description: Detects storage of sensitive data without encryption at rest in databases, file systems, or object stores
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%data-protection%' OR payload ILIKE '%encryption-at-rest%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES
